claims: The Social Security Administration (SSA) issues payments on April 8, 2026 to beneficiaries born between the 1st and 10th of any month.
April 8 payments follow April 3rd payments for those who received benefits before May 1997 or receive SSI.
April 8, 2026 is the second Wednesday of the month.
The average payment for retired workers is approximately $1,928.
SSA issues payments on April 15, the third Wednesday, to beneficiaries with birthdays on the 11th–20th.
SSA issues payments on April 22, the fourth Wednesday, to beneficiaries with birthdays on the 21st–31st.
The SSA recommends waiting three additional mailing days before contacting them if a payment does not arrive on time.
